title: Outpatient and Inpatient Patient Registration Process
content: All patients must be registered in the HIS at their first contact using a government-issued photo ID and current contact details; patients with previous visits must have their record retrieved and verified rather than re-registered. A unique MRN is generated by the HIS at first registration and is the patient's permanent identifier across all visits and departments. For inpatient admissions, registration must include: admission type (emergency/elective/daycare), admitting physician, expected length of stay, and bed/room preference. Insurance details must be captured at registration; the insurance team must verify coverage electronically within 30 minutes for planned admissions. Patient demographic data must be reviewed and updated at each encounter to ensure accuracy. Consent for treatment and privacy notice acknowledgment must be obtained and scanned into HIS at the time of each admission.
